title: An in-flight change that declares a shared input covers an accepted change for now
description: An in-flight change that declares a shared input covers an accepted change for now
acceptance_criteria: an accepted change whose signed input an approved later change declaring its module and path has edited reads provisionally-covered naming that change; audit warns instead of failing; it archives with coverage.json naming the covering change; with no such change it is stale and audit fails as before

answers.constraints: a provisionally covered change neither covers another change nor replaces one in a retirement; reopen stays allowed; archived integrity is unchanged
